data.gender_notes: Assiratun is used as a gender_neutral name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Assiratun is the Arabic name for 'The Bridge.' It is a symbolic name for the bridge that leads us from this world to the next. It is a reminder of the importance of following the correct path in life, as the bridge is the only way to cross the river that separates us from our ultimate destination. The name Assiratun carries the meaning “The Bridge [to God]” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in arabic. Parents who choose Assiratun usually hope their child will grow to embody the bridge [to god] and live with faith, good character and purpose.

This bridge is named Sirat in Arabic, and it is said to be very narrow, fine as a cobweb, and very tight. Those who cross it are only able to do so one foot at a time, with the help of Allah's grace. Therefore, the name Assiratun can be seen as a reminder of the importance of staying on the right path and avoiding any wrongdoings, as the bridge is the only way to cross and reach the ultimate destination.
